name: bmo-frontend
description: Third-party front-end libraries for BMO, managed via npm so security updates flow through Dependabot instead of hand-vendored blobs.
//: Versions are pinned to what was previously vendored so this change is behaviour-neutral. Dependabot proposes upgrades; treat majors (jquery 4.x, mermaid 11.x, devbridge 2.x) as manual, tested reviews. bpopup is not published to npm and remains vendored under js/jquery/plugins/bPopup/.
